title: Malaysian Curry Brunch Strata
description: A hearty brunch dish with a Malaysian twist, featuring curry-infused bread, eggs, and crumbled patissiere. Perfect for a weekend morning.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté curry leaves and ginger until fragrant.
Add Malaysian Curry Bread to skillet and toast until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and crème fraîche until well combined.
Add toasted bread mixture to bowl and stir until eggs are fully coated.
Pour mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle crumbled patissière on top of egg mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until eggs are set and bread is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional curry leaves if desired.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
